description:
Yes! Tardigrades (water bears) survived 10 days in OPEN SPACE in a 2007 ESA experiment. The ones shielded from sunlight revived, walked, and laid eggs that hatched normally.
They dry into a 'tun' state, shutting their bodies down to nearly zero — and a protein called Dsup shields their DNA from radiation.
OTIS — dumb questions, wild answers.
#tardigrade #waterbear #space
title: Can Tardigrades Survive Space? 🐻 #Shorts
